shortDescription: 20.19.0.v202611232103 (Deluxe) for CyberLink 9 Languages + RUS + PTB (Enu, Cht, Chs, Jpn, Kor, Deu, Esp, Fra, Ita, Rus, Ptb) (R8)

env.testedBy: AI agent (Claude Opus 5.5) driving the phone over Appium; verdicts and evidence reviewed by WILLY_WU
env.install: TR build 20.19.0.v202611232103 (versionCode 90201902, SR PHA261029-01); installed APK MD5 matches the TR's Cyberlink.MD5
env.scope: every eBug on this TR's verify list (PHD-A rule)

observations: Swipe Collage Template Page: the current page's dot on a card is white with no outline, so it disappears on a light template (「20 photos · 6 pages」).
Swipe Collage Template Preview: opening it from a card swiped to page 2 starts at page 1; pages take about 10 s to load.
Swipe Collage restored canvas: undo is greyed and ✕ leaves with no 「Discard changes?」.

AI Hair Color Custom: with Solid the Highlight Color row stays shown greyed instead of hidden; the collapsed Custom cell keeps its wand icon instead of the chosen colour; top corner radius about 13–15 dp against the PM's 20 pt.

Swipe Collage draft: a force stop sent by adb while the canvas is still in front keeps no draft, so no 「Continue editing?」 then (Edit Room still asks in that case); once the app has gone to the background first, as when it is closed from Recents or Settings, the dialog appears.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: Template card thumbnails and the Template Preview stay blank, with no page dots
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Template cards now show the template's first page with page dots, and the Template Preview shows its pages and dots.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: Background textures and Add Layer frames carry no PRO crown or NEW tag
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: PRO textures and frames now carry a crown; no item shows a NEW tag, as none appears to be marked new in the CMS.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: Free user gets no IAP page at the 3rd export or any later one
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: A Free user now gets the PhotoDirector Premium page at the 3rd and 6th export.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: No 「Continue editing?」 after the app is killed during editing; edits are lost
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: After the app is closed with a Swipe Collage edit open, 「Continue editing?」 appears on entering Swipe Collage and Continue restores the edit.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent][UI] AI_Hair_Color: Custom panel shows ︽ not ⌄, keeps the ✕ ↩ ↪ ✓ row, square corners
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: The Custom panel now has a grab handle and rounded top corners, with no ✕ ↩ ↪ ✓ row under it, as the Design draws.

rows.title: PHD-A 20.19.0 - [AIAgent] Swipe_Collage: App crashes on every open after it was closed with a canvas being edited
rows.creator: WILLY_WU
rows.summary: Swipe Collage now opens normally after a force stop with a canvas being edited, and a saved draft restores without a crash.
